rv.q: As had the rest of the very young West End audience with an average age of, I'd say, 27, who stood and cheered this production of The Last Five Years to the rafters.
The Last Five Years really is a slice of perfection.

cn.t: Jason Robert Brown's musical finally reaches the West End after pandemic delays, with critics praising its innovative concept and the composer's genius, though one reviewer shows slightly more measured enthusiasm than the other's effusive response.
